If you're a TikTok creator, you might be wondering if you can pin comments on your videos. The short answer is, unfortunately, no—TikTok used to have a comment pinning feature, but it was removed. However, some TikTok creators have discovered a workaround for this missing feature by using video replies. Keep reading to learn more.

## TikTok Pinned Comments: How They Work

While TikTok creators used to be able to pin comments on their videos, TikTok removed the pinned comment feature sometime in 2022. Some users have discovered that you can work around the removal of pinned comments by video-replying to a comment, which pushes it to the top of the comments section.

## Steps

Section 1 of 3:

### Can you still pin TikTok comments?

1. [![No, you cannot pin TikTok comments anymore.](https://www.wikihow.com/images/thumb/9/97/Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-1.jpg/v4-460px-Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-1.jpg)](https://www.wikihow.com/Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok#/Image:Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-1.jpg)

**No, you cannot pin TikTok comments anymore.** TikTok quietly removed the ability to pin [comments](https://www.wikihow.com/Like,-Comment-or-Share-on-TikTok "Like, Comment or Share on TikTok") sometime in 2022, which upset many creators who used the pinned comment for video corrections, sources, or more information. However, you can still "pin" comments to your videos using what some creators call a "shadow pin" workaround.[\[1\]](https://www.wikihow.com/Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok#_note-1)XResearch source


Advertisement

Section 2 of 3:

### Workaround to Pin TikTok Comments

1. [![Step 1 Make a video reply to the comment you want to pin.](https://www.wikihow.com/images/thumb/8/81/Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-2.jpg/v4-460px-Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-2.jpg)](https://www.wikihow.com/Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok#/Image:Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-2.jpg)

1

**Make a video reply to the comment you want to pin.** When you make a video reply to a [comment](https://www.wikihow.com/Post-Picture-in-Comments "Post Picture in Comments"), the comment will be boosted to the top of the comments section.


   - To make a video reply, find the comment you want to reply to (or pin, in this case), long press it, and select **Reply with Video**.
   - You can then start to record your video. For the purpose of pinning a comment, however, you can record just a couple of seconds.
   - Post the video reply once you're finished.

2. [![Step 2 Private the video reply you just made.](https://www.wikihow.com/images/thumb/0/06/Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-3.jpg/v4-460px-Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-3.jpg)](https://www.wikihow.com/Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok#/Image:Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-3.jpg)

2

**Private the video reply you just made.** This will leave the comment you video replied to at the top of the comment section, but the video reply will not show. Since there is no visual indicator that the top comment is pinned, however, you may want to preface any pinned comments you write with `Pinned comment:`.


   - To private a video reply, open it and tap the three-dot menu in the bottom-right corner. Then tap **Privacy settings** and select **Only you** under "Who can watch this video".

     - You can also toggle off the ability for others to comment, Duet, Stitch, and more at the bottom of the privacy menu.

Section 3 of 3:

### Best Comments to Pin

1. [![While you can pin any comment, some comments are a better choice than others.](https://www.wikihow.com/images/thumb/4/4a/Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-4.jpg/v4-460px-Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-4.jpg)](https://www.wikihow.com/Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok#/Image:Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok-Step-4.jpg)

**While you can pin any comment, some comments are a better choice than others.** The best comments to pin in your TikTok video's comment section are:


   - Corrections
   - Additional information or clarification
   - Responses to common commenter question(s)
   - Sources
   - Directives to a part 2 video
   - An interesting perspective from a viewer
   - A funny comment that made you laugh
     - Don't discount the value of a funny comment! Jenna Jean Davis, social media influencer, marketer, and the founder and CEO of Jenna Jean Marketing LLC, says that "the comment section of TikTok is almost as entertaining as the videos themselves."[\[2\]](https://www.wikihow.com/Pin-a-Comment-on-Tiktok#_note-2)X [Expert Source](https://www.wikihow.com/wikiHow:Delivering-a-Trustworthy-Experience) [![Jenna Jean Davis](https://www.wikihow.com/images/thumb/8/86/Jenna_Jean.png/-crop-100-100-100px-Jenna_Jean.png)Jenna Jean Davis\\
